title: rosa afzeliana f. lapicidinarum
intro: Rosa afzeliana f. lapicidinarum, commonly known as the Indian rose, is a variant of the Rosa afzeliana species. It is a plant traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa afzeliana f. lapicidinarum include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate digestive issues, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
